fullPassage: Bee societies are both complex and collaborative. While the queen is certainly treated like a royal, with an entourage of her children tending to her every need, bees make big decisions democratically, not by royal decree. When a colony gets too large, a group of some thousands of bees will split off and create a new colony. But deciding where to establish a new home is no simple task for these intelligent and opinionated insects. To come to an educated group decision, they set up a temporary camp and send scouts to explore the surrounding areas, relating accounts of their journeys upon their return through the language of interpretive dance. Other bees then set out on a property viewing with the scout whose dance they found most compelling, after which they return and present their own dances for those who remain undecided. After many rounds of 'voting', the location that gathers majority support becomes the site of the new colony.

questions.passage: Bee societies are both complex and collaborative. While the queen is certainly treated like a royal, with an entourage of her children tending to her every need, bees make big decisions democratically, not by royal decree. When a colony gets too large, a group of some thousands of bees will split off and create a new colony. But deciding where to establish a new home is no simple task for these intelligent and opinionated insects. To come to an educated group decision, <u>they</u> set up a temporary camp and send scouts to explore the surrounding areas, relating accounts of their journeys upon their return through the language of interpretive dance. Other bees then set out on a property viewing with the scout whose dance they found most compelling, after which they return and present their own dances for those who remain undecided. After many rounds of 'voting', the location that gathers majority support becomes the site of the new colony.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: they = 분리된 벌 무리 (새 군집을 만들기 위해 떨어져 나온 수천 마리의 벌들)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 새 군집을 위해 분리된 벌 무리: 앞 문장의 a group of some thousands of bees를 받음.
❌ ① 여왕벌과 수행원단: 여왕은 결정에 관여하지 않음.
❌ ② 주변 지역의 정찰벌들: 정찰벌은 they가 보내는 대상.
❌ ④ 결정을 못한 벌들: undecided bees는 뒤에 등장.
det.tip: they = a group of some thousands of bees(분리된 수천 마리)
